newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends mostly lower on CBOT, crushers buy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends mostly lower on CBOT, crushers buy.

text.p: WCE canola ended mostly down on lower CBOT soycomplex values despite a bullish Statistics Canada canola stocks report earlier Monday.

"Cargill Europe was selling March, May and July and crushers were buying the March," a trader said. March futures crush profit margin rose to -27.35 from -30.38 on CBOT soyoil and meal. March-May spread at $0.30, March-July at even money.
Japan bought 1,000-2,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola fell $1.20 to $403.90 a tonne and May shed $1.90 to $404.10. Volume was 3,982 lots, or 79,640 tonnes, with 170 hedges. March flax lost $0.50 to $342.70 on commercials.
March feed wheat fell $1 to $169 as UGG sold and Alberta Wheat Pool bought scale down. March-May spread at $3.80. Lower values were due to StatsCan, traders said. Volume was 400.
February western barley rose $0.50 to $137 with Benson Quinn and Alberta Wheat Pool selling to PCTS and UGG. Feb-Mar spread at $2. Volume was 1,100 lots. Oats did not trade.
Royal Bank sold 50 May feed peas down US$0.50 at US$197 to UGG, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats and peas.)
